name: Aulie-Ata
note: Market town on the Talas below the Karatau, on the old Aulie-Ata of the Kokand khanate and the Russian uezd town; much of the Soviet city was abandoned after 1992 and 2007 and has been cleared back to the old core. Gives its name to the Aulie-Ata cattle of the Talas valley.
